Model Legislation
for a Synthetic Lantern Registry

Part 1. General Requirements
Section 101. Definitions.
(1) "Lantern" means a portable lamp sold in [State].
(2) "Registrar" means the office named under [insert state code].
Section 102. Registration of lanterns.
(1) Beginning [insert date], a seller shall register each lantern.
(2) A seller shall keep the record for [two] years.1
OR ANOTHER MORE LIMITED OPTION THAN REGISTRATION
Section 102. Notice of sale.
A seller shall give the registrar notice of each sale.
1 An invented footnote that explains the choice of years.
2 ethics and public policy center · www.eppc.org
Part 2. Enforcement
Section 201. Enforcement by the attorney general.
The attorney general may bring an action under this [act].
[Drafting Note: an invented note to the drafter.]
Commentary
An invented paragraph of commentary that no state would enact.
Section 202. Severability.
If any provision of this [act] is held invalid, the rest stands.

Effective date.
This [act] takes effect on [insert date].
